title: Zesty Grassy Moroccan Pine Nuts Seffa
description: A kid-friendly Moroccan dish featuring pine nuts, with a grassy and crumbly texture, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients and a zesty flavor, in the form of seffa.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the pine nuts in a baking sheet for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cook the vermicelli pasta according to package instructions, then set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked vermicelli pasta to the bowl and toss to coat with the lemon juice mixture.
Stir in the toasted pine nuts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the seffa to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
